programme.title: Gumrah
programme.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. programme.title: Ittefaq
programme.desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.

programme.title: Karishma
programme.desc: A photographer joins up with a group of supermodels, who are sent abroad by a businessman. However, all is not as it seems as other models in similar situations keep showing up dead under suspicious circumstances.
